notes.title: Learn the tools of the trade
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/38324ac98c8e0d8e0f20c1f0117bc7d84064715b.png[/img]

Hey renovators! It’s time to review what tools will be left at your disposal in [b]Airport Renovator[/b]. Those of you who played the demo are likely to know exactly what kind of equipment is available and what each piece is used for. Those who didn’t play the [b]Airport Renovator[/b] demo can utilise this knowledge to become renovation experts in a very short period of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/9c6b295c617a58504206c5b6554e499a93c2c712.png[/img]

The trusty [b]Axe[/b] is your second best companion – considering that the goat is your first. You can use the axe to break padlocks, demolish trash and obviously, chop down trees. It will be very useful in clearing out the area around the runway and clearing the airport out of unwanted scrap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/d840acfed0ebb2851021c188f07fdbdcb3fd03c6.png[/img]

The [b]Dust Blower[/b] is a handy device that can easily clear the runway from sand and dust for a smooth landing and takeoff. It also seems to work like kryptonite for the overly friendly goat. If you need some time alone, just point it at the little bugger and see what happens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/b8e35397b8e7cfa5205f656891686133e48c532d.png[/img]

The [b]Pressure Washer[/b] is by far one of the most powerful tools in Airport Renovator. It removes stains and dirt with unimaginable force. Think about a pod of 100 whales blowing out water all at once – it is nothing near to what our [b]Pressure Washer[/b] is capable of. Sadly, it won’t remove blueberry stains from your favourite shirt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/977c2c3a1cb4e1148860f8ebdd000e5ead9dd5ff.png[/img]

[b]Grass Trimmer[/b] does not have an easy life in [b]Airport Renovator[/b]. If you want your airport to look flawless, you’re going to have to use the trimmer very often. It does exactly what you expect – gets rid of all those pesky weeds around the runway, terminal and hangar. There’s nothing like the smell of freshly cut grass in the morning.

notes.title: GOAT - the greatest of all time
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/c10719748296164752a2bfea5da33bc0d9979167.png[/img]

As soon as you start making your first steps in the Airport Renovator, you realize that a goat is walking on the old terminal building. If you’re asking yourself, “how did this poor animal get up there?” you are a straight-thinking human being, and I applaud you for that in those weird times, we are living in.

But the real question is, how can you get it down? Well, there are a couple of ways to do it. The first one is to grab the stairs standing next to the hangar and bring them close to the goat - that will get it down for sure. The other way is to use the dust blower and blow it down with an impact! Yes, the dust blower works perfectly with our beloved goat. You can play an air ping-pong with it, trying to keep the animal flying in the air without falling for a long time! 

The goat becomes your companion for the rest of the game. It follows you with an annoying “maa” and sometimes gets in the way of your work. Don’t worry - you can always send it away with a push of the [h3]“F” [/h3]button. 

In the latest Halloween update to the Airport Renovator, our goat gets possessed by demons, and you can bring it back to normal by taking it to a secret pumpkin circle! There’s even a special achievement for this action in the demo!

Love it or hate it, the goat is a viral part of the Airport Renovator, and we can’t wait for it to do more stuff in the full version of the game!

notes.title: Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it’s a loot crate!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/7dae73575661c92c51d8989d963f718c20052a85.png[/img]

A[b] loot crate [/b]in the [b]Airport Renovator[/b] is like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re gonna get! Well, almost. But let’s start from the beginning.

Depending on the game’s story, once in a while, your in-game pilot friend will (whose identity we don’t want to disclose at the moment) airdrops you a large wooden box. You will quickly recognize a majestic umbrella of a parachute slowly descending into the old airstrip. After it lands, you need to [b]grab your axe [/b]and chop that tangible thing into pieces. Let me tell you - [b]it’s a satisfying process[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/fa22862afa58315572f7c5e23a6ef38251a08085.png[/img]

After that, you can finally grab your reward. Boxes can contain [b]a tool [/b]for your arsenal, an element of the [b]airport equipment[/b], or even something that you don’t expect! For example, after you’ve received a grass trimmer, it is added to your tool shed forever, and you can start using it right away. 

[b]Airdrops [/b]are a crucial part of the Airport Renovator gameplay, and from the moment you see a wooden crate flying through the air to the moment you take a new toy into your hand, they are pure joy.

[b]The Airport Renovator Demo is coming on the 1st of October!
[/b]

notes.title: Trim your bush with a grass trimmer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/e07560b94b264e5a87720507e4241d200c47d50a.png[/img]

In [b]Airport Renovator[/b], it’s you and your tools against Mother Nature. The airport you’re taking care of needs a human hand, and it needs it now! When you enter the game first, you see the overgrown bushes, the trees that are way too high for any pilot to see through them, and the grass that covers the airfield like a vast, green carpet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/62daa2144353de380ba11e26c9e714a7e9c31747.gif[/img]

Here is where your trusty [b]grass trimmer[/b] comes into play, start it up and trim away! Leave no bush unattended and no grass obstructing the essential parts of the airport. Don’t worry. The process of trimming is relaxing, and you can’t cut yourself while doing it. It’s just a game, after all…

Prepare the airport area for the next game stage with your grass trimmer, and remember - [b]a trimmed airfield makes the plane appear bigger![/b]
